column1: # Doors for the box `coder`. One row per door: name, program inside the box, one endpoint
# (host:port:access:protocol:enforcement). `audit` = log and allow, used for the first week so the log
# gives the real request list; then the row is tightened to `enforce` with explicit rules.
# A door is opened only after the operator approved it by name; the commit that adds it is the record.
# openshell/policy.yaml is the record of every live door (including ones approved from a pending rule);
# after opening one, run bin/drift-check.sh --capture and commit.
